witness.branch: Access-sign coverage and geographically specified riding
witness.quote: This area shall be posted with signs indicating that the riding of bicycles, electric bicycles, or electric scooters on the sidewalk is prohibited.
witness.reason: The road scene can include the specified sidewalk governed by the fixed access restriction sign.
required_context: Establish actual riding and classification as bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter, preserving the supplied classification requirements and exclusions.
Establish sign content covering all three categories, placement and spatial coverage. Posting is a separate obligation, not an expressly stated prerequisite to the riding prohibition.
Establish sign instructions covering sidewalk riding of all three named categories and the sign's spatial extent.
Establish the named Fremont Street extent and a connected sidewalk within the road scene.
Establish the sidewalk and route on Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street; the geographic reading remains an assumption pending map evidence.
Place a classified covered rider on the governed sidewalk; sign presence alone does not establish prohibited participant classes.
Preserve the separate posting obligation without treating posting as an express prerequisite to the riding prohibition.
Preserve unresolved applicability of the supplied NRS bicycle and sidewalk definitions and the unspecified consequence of absent or deficient signs.
witness.subject_reason: This party can be the covered rider; it is not thereby the actor responsible for posting.
